entries.title: A note from Firstmate stays up after its task finishes
entries.body: When a task finishes, a note Firstmate put up about it now stays until you close it. If Firstmate still has a question for you on a task that answered something, that task stays open until you answer it.

picture.alt: A Firstmate note, Own vs rent: owning Macs wins for steady use, still open with its reply field
